meaning:
νομή, -ῆς, ἡ
(νέμω, to pasture), [in LXX chiefly for מִרְעֶה, also for נָוֶה, etc. ;]
1. a pasture, pasturage: figuratively, Jhn.10:9
2. a grazing, feeding; metaphorically, of a spreading sore, 2Ti.2:17 (Polyb.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
